findings: The 2026-11-07 capture of https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/ideal is a 14-line index with hosted and Direct API variant links, not either variant body (new lines 5–14). The current source is dated 2026-05-13 and cites the 1015-line older capture. A bounded historical correction is warranted because source lines 13 and 17–22 merge two older variant flows: hosted Checkout charges the first subscription payment through iDEAL, or charges and immediately refunds 0.01 EUR when there is a free trial (old lines 16–18); Direct API generally charges and refunds 0.01 EUR through iDEAL for bank-detail setup, then uses the generated SEPA Direct Debit PaymentMethod for the subscription (old lines 541–549, 838–850). The unqualified 'first payment' and 'all subsequent' sequence in source lines 17–20 is not an accurate common sequence.

In the older Direct API variant, SEPA Direct Debit activation and iDEAL/SEPA terms are prerequisites (old line 549). A SetupIntent with ideal tracks setup and the iDEAL | Wero SEPA mandate (old line 585), and its success permits retrieval of latest_attempt.payment_method_details.generated_sepa_debit (old lines 832–850). Setup authorization is separate from later SEPA payment success and active subscription status (old lines 870–874). Accounts v2 customer_account and Customers v1 customer are distinct example identities (old lines 583–610).

Source line 45 should describe reliable confirmation of SetupIntent authorization, with webhooks as an optional method rather than a required listener: the old heading says 'Optional: Monitor webhooks' and advises a method such as webhooks instead of relying on customer return (old lines 832–834). Source line 50 should retain off_session=true only as this older Direct API guide's subscription-update instruction (old lines 876–878), dropping the unsupported PayPal analogy and universal 'always' framing.

This source-required correction is for May 2026 source accuracy, not a claim of new November behavior. Keep the source date and older factual raw reference; do not add the November navigation-only index to factual raw_files.
